families.topic: planning, inspection and control of collapse, falls, services and water hazards in excavations
families.guard: Excavation risk depends on ground conditions, depth, support or battering, nearby structures, services, weather, water, plant movements and inspection findings.

families.topic: planning, competence, exclusion zones, structural stability and supervision during demolition
families.guard: Demolition risk depends on the structure, sequence, demolition method, temporary support, exclusion zones, plant, debris trajectory, utilities and worker competence.

families.topic: competent design, erection, inspection, fall protection and access security for scaffolds
families.guard: Scaffold safety depends on design, foundations, ties, loading, erection sequence, inspection history, weather, modification, access control and user behaviour.

families.source: HSE ladder and stepladder safety guidance
families.topic: selection, competence, pre-use checks, securing, positioning and inspection of ladders
families.guard: Ladder risk depends on task duration and force, ladder type and condition, ground, angle, securing, access height, weather, carried loads and user competence.

families.topic: planning and control of falls, fragile surfaces, access and rescue during roof work
families.guard: Roof-work risk depends on roof pitch and condition, fragility, edges and openings, weather, access, work duration, equipment, falling objects and rescue arrangements.

families.source: HSE rider-operated lift-truck safety and training guidance
families.topic: operator competence, staged training, supervision, monitoring and safe use of lift trucks
families.guard: Lift-truck risk depends on truck type and attachment, load, stability, speed, routes, pedestrians, surface and slopes, maintenance, supervision and operator competence.

families.source: HSE loading and unloading safety guidance
families.topic: site separation, vehicle stability, load security, coordination and drive-away prevention
families.guard: Loading risk depends on vehicle and trailer condition, ground, load distribution and restraint, lift-truck movement, overhead services, communication and drive-away controls.

families.source: HSE waste and recycling machinery-safety guidance
families.topic: guarding, isolation, maintenance, competence and lifting-equipment controls in waste operations
families.guard: Waste-machinery risk depends on equipment type, guarding, isolation, blockage clearing, maintenance, lifting accessories, examination, traffic interaction and competence.

families.topic: guarding, braking, tooling, extraction, training and safe operation of woodworking machinery
families.guard: Woodworking-machinery risk depends on machine type, guarding, cutters and tooling, feed method, kickback, braking, extraction, maintenance, materials and operator competence.

families.source: HSE ionising-radiation protection and notification guidance
families.topic: risk assessment, exposure restriction, notification, registration, consent and dose monitoring
families.guard: Ionising-radiation risk depends on source type and activity, energy, shielding, distance, time, contamination routes, work practice, accident potential and dose monitoring.

families.topic: radon risk assessment, measurement, notification, remediation and review
families.guard: Radon risk depends on geology, building location and structure, floor level, ventilation, occupancy, measurement duration, seasonal variation and remediation performance.

families.source: HSE artificial and natural optical-radiation guidance
families.topic: assessment and control of ultraviolet, visible, infrared and laser radiation
families.guard: Optical-radiation risk depends on wavelength, source power, beam geometry, exposure duration and distance, reflections, shielding, skin and eye protection and worker sensitivity.

families.topic: assessment of EMF exposure, exposure limits, action plans, indirect effects and vulnerable workers
families.guard: EMF risk depends on field frequency and intensity, distance, exposure duration, equipment mode, conductive objects, implanted devices and worker-specific susceptibility.

families.topic: classification, risk assessment, containment, incident response and notification for biological agents
families.guard: Biological-agent risk depends on agent and hazard group, transmission route, concentration and volume, procedure, containment, worker immunity, vaccination and incident response.

families.topic: PPE, warm facilities, breaks, scheduling, symptom recognition and weather-related work controls
families.guard: Cold-weather risk depends on temperature, wind, rain, clothing, work rate, duration, shelter, health, fatigue, equipment handling and emergency arrangements.

families.topic: tank siting, security, impact protection, pipework maintenance and emergency arrangements
families.guard: LPG risk depends on tank and pipework condition, siting, ventilation, ignition sources, traffic impact, security, ownership, maintenance, leak detection and emergency response.
